finding: All tactical-suite tools were absent from Foundry 14 Token Controls in a module-heavy adventure world even though the four manual packages were active and the NPC AI package was inactive.
fix: After registered manual features finish startup, the shared runtime rebuilds Foundry SceneControls with the supported reset render option so its cached tool model includes the suite controls.

tests.regression: Manual-suite startup requests exactly one scene-control reset after feature registration.
